assessment.model_case: The projected mean of about 0.54 assists on 17.7 projected minutes supports a near-coin-flip chance of at least one assist, while the median remains zero. assessment.price_case: This is a single 0.5 main line at +165, with a break-even near 38 in 100. Fair odds of about +139 sit well inside the quote. The market-weighted blend leaves only a small cushion. Only one other book supports the consensus, which is not broad.
